about_the_game:
"SD Dungeons" is a top-down rogue-like action game.

Customize your character to your liking with a variety of parts and accessories,
then choose your favorite from six different jobs.
Utilize unique skills and actions for each job and weapon to reach the depths of the dungeon!

As you progress through randomly generated dungeon floors,
you’ll encounter monsters, traps, and fate-changing gates.
Beyond the gate awaits paradise, hell… or perhaps a formidable boss!?

You might obtain powerful weapons and armor from treasure chests, monsters, or bosses!
Will you push forward in search of legendary items,
or escape safely to steadily accumulate gear and experience? The choice is yours!

＜Character Creation＞

Choose from various hairstyles, hair colors, eyes, and accessories to create your perfect look!
Whether cute or cool, design your character just the way you like!

＜Dungeon＞

The game features two types of challenges:
randomly generated "Dungeons" and fixed-stage "Quests."
Want to test out different jobs or weapons? Try the Quest mode!

＜Gates＞

There are many types of gates, such as the "Normal Gate," "Gate of Ruin," and "Escape Gate."
A variety of gates appear randomly at each floor transition,
and the one you choose will determine the difficulty of the next floor.

＜Jobs＞

Choose from six unique jobs!

■ Fighter

A melee job that wields a sword and shield.
With balanced attack and defense, it’s easy to handle.
Switch between standard attacks and counters to control the fight!

■ Ranger

A long-range job that uses a bow.
Low defense, but exceptional range!
Take advantage of distance to attack freely!

■ Sorcerer

A long-range job that wields a staff.
Like the Ranger, it has low defense, but can cast powerful magic.
Charge your magic to alter its effects!?

■ Monk

A melee job that fights with fists and dual daggers.
Lower attack and defense, with short range, but excellent mobility.
Dodge enemy attacks and strike relentlessly as an infighter!

■ Warrior

A melee job that wields a greatsword.
Slow movement, but devastating attack power.
Observe enemy movements and land a mighty blow!

■ Gunner

A ranged job that uses dual guns.
Shorter range than the Ranger, but allows for rapid attacks.
Take down enemies with stylish shooting action!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: intel core-i5-4000
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForece GTX960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Controller recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: intel core-i7-4720
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Controller recommended

short_description: Create your favorite character and embark on a grand adventure! Randomly generated dungeons and gates that determine your fate await you on each floor! Can you escape with powerful weapons and gems before you run out of strength!?
